svg.title: Promotion condition decision tree
svg.desc: Both conditions promote in place for the only reader. With other readers, ONLY_READER fails while retaining READ ownership and SHARED_READER transfers the existing fix count through a queue-head WRITE request. Both reject a second promoter.
svg.text: Choose whether contention should fail now or transfer ownership through a wait
Caller T already holds READ, fix_count = k
Question: does T own every current fix on this BCB?
holder.fix_count == BCB.fcnt ?
also reject if a promoter is already first
YES · T is the only fixer
Both conditions: in-place success
READ → WRITE; holder and fix_count k stay in place
No sleep, no ownership gap, same unfix debt
NO · another reader exists
PGBUF_PROMOTE_ONLY_READER
Return ER_PAGE_LATCH_PROMOTE_FAIL immediately
T keeps READ holder + fix_count k; caller may restart/skip
PGBUF_PROMOTE_SHARED_READER
1 · subtract k from BCB.fcnt and remove T's holder
2 · queue WRITE(k) at the head and sleep
3 · after readers drain, restore WRITE holder count k
Second-promoter rule
If queue head is already a promoter, both choices fail.
The current caller keeps its READ ownership.
One BCB has at most one waiting continuity bridge.
Condition changes the contended path; it does not change the uncontended in-place path.
